parameters.query: SELECT i.id,i.student_id,u.email,u.full_name,b.title,i.due_date,GREATEST(0,CURRENT_DATE-i.due_date)::int late_days FROM book_issues i JOIN users u ON u.id=i.student_id JOIN books b ON b.id=i.book_id WHERE i.status IN ('ISSUED','OVERDUE') AND u.active=true AND i.due_date<CURRENT_DATE;

parameters.jsCode: return items.map(({json})=>{const fine=json.late_days*5;return {json:{...json,fine,subject:'Library book overdue reminder',message:`Hello ${json.full_name}, your book "${json.title}" was due on ${String(json.due_date).slice(0,10)} and is ${json.late_days} day(s) overdue. The current estimated fine is ₹${fine}. Please return it as soon as possible.`}};});
